articles.summary_hinglish: asama raiphalsa ke javanon ne siaarapiepha aura manipura pulisa ke satha milakara manipura ke kangapokapi jile ke sehajanga ganva men avaidha posta ki kheti ko nashta kara diya। pitiaaee phaila photo inphal, 10 navanbar: manipura pulisa ne mangalavara ko kaha ki usane anya suraksha balon ki madada se rajya ke 10 jilon ke 516 ganvon men avaidha posta ki kheti ko nashta karane ki yojana banaee hai।
